# mcp-server

Example resource for the SuperCoder protocol.

warnings.effect: This resource also declares agent-skills; only the current target is exported.
warnings.mitigation: Export separately for each target: agent-skills.

warnings.effect: ChatGPT has no file-based MCP configuration, so the server definition is not exported.
warnings.mitigation: Register the server through the environment's own UI.

warnings.effect: The package must be uploaded through ChatGPT's Skills page; there is no public API for installing a skill into an account. Availability depends on workspace plan and administrator settings.
warnings.mitigation: Upload via Skills > Create > Upload from your computer.
